goal: Travel from Pewter City through Mt Moon to reach Cerulean City.

subgoals.goal_text: Visit the Pewter City Pokemon Center to ensure the party is fully healed before heading out.
Go to the Pewter Mart and buy Potions to sustain the party through Mt Moon.
Leave Pewter City and enter Route 3.
Travel through Route 3 to reach the entrance of Mt Moon.
Navigate through the first floor of Mt Moon and descend to the basement (B1F).
Navigate through the first basement and descend to the second basement (B2F).
Find and defeat the Super Nerd guarding the fossils on B2F.
Find the exit of Mt Moon and move to the Pokemon Center area.
Heal the party at the Mt Moon Pokemon Center before the final stretch.
Leave the Mt Moon center area and enter Route 4.
Travel through Route 4 until you reach Cerulean City.
